DevGuard Helm Repository

Helm chart for DevGuard — open-source software supply chain security, vulnerability management, and compliance. 

helm repo add devguard __BASE_URL__
helm repo update
helm install devguard devguard/devguard

Verifying a chart

Chart packages are signed with OpenPGP; every package is published alongside a .prov provenance file. 

curl -sLO __BASE_URL__/signing-key.asc
gpg --dearmor < signing-key.asc > signing-key.gpg
helm pull devguard/devguard --prov
helm verify devguard-*.tgz --keyring ./signing-key.gpg
